facts.fact: The Supreme Court and UNDP signed an agreement to implement digital governance systems in the Supreme Court and the Malabo and Bata provincial courts, and the Court paid 90 million FCFA as an initial contribution toward IT equipment to digitise case files.

systems.owner: Corte Suprema de Justicia with UNDP
systems.tiers: Supreme Court, Malabo and Bata provincial courts

systems.system: digitalisation of the administration of justice project
systems.owner: Supreme Court of Justice with UNDP

note: A UNDP technical reconnaissance visit to survey court systems and case registers; nothing procured, piloted or built is stated.

systems.system: Sistema digital para la gestión de casos judiciales
systems.owner: Corte Suprema de Justicia / PNUD project

note: The document only says a case management system 'se implementará'; the delivery was IT equipment, so nothing is under way or in service.
